name: 证据门控的自动分析角度采用
purpose: Convert semantic angle candidates into auditable adoptions only after deterministic adaptation, strict contract checks, and evidence validation.
eligibility_checks: proposed adoption count is at most 4
assumptions: host-generated candidates are proposals and referenced evidence cards belong to the locked run
human_gates: confirm coverage and counterexample plans describe the actual corpus
diagnostics: per-candidate contract errors, evidence errors, rejection reasons, and adoption counts
allowed_claims: candidate passed or failed declared gates
adopted angle has verified supporting evidence and may proceed to finding generation
forbidden_claims: angle adoption answers the core question
